title: The public Templates header shows Download app beside Get Started, in the bar and in the phone menu
steps: S1: Render the Templates header with the English words and list its links in order.
expect: S1: Free Templates, Help Center, Download app, Get Started in the phone menu, then Download app and Get Started in the bar; both Download app links point to https://tracy.ai/download/.
evidence: Before this change the Templates header had no Download app button, while the tracy.ai menu keeps it beside Get Started
fence: Static render of the header function; the public Templates page test covers the full page
